overview: The board granted a one-year extension for a 40-unit residential project and continued a residential variance hearing pending a certified plot plan. Members also received legal training on the Massachusetts Zoning Act and Medford’s recently recodified zoning ordinance.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue Extension
items.summary: Approved a 12-month extension for a previously granted variance and special permit to demolish a gas station and construct a 40-unit, mixed-use building.

items.title: 5 Russell Street Variance
items.summary: Continued the application to convert a detached garage into a workshop until August 25 to allow the applicant to provide a certified plot plan verifying that the lot can accommodate two legal parking spaces.

items.title: Zoning Board Training Session
items.summary: Legal counsel provided a comprehensive presentation on the Zoning Act, variances, special permits, and the city's recent zoning recodification.
